purpose: Add a second major Spain-facing operator as an independent source of exact progressive mechanics, contribution rates, trigger conditions and seed/reset semantics.

titles.poolSegmentation: one progressive jackpot per fixed bet-per-line value
titles.trigger: 10 consecutive winning results in main game or qualifying Bonus Dice results; free-spin wins do not count
titles.statePersistence: consecutive-win counter is remembered separately for each bet-per-line setting when the player changes bet or exits and restored on return
titles.losingSpinBehavior: a non-winning spin resets the consecutive-win counter; after streaks of 4-9 it awards the corresponding Lucky Free Games benefit
titles.concurrencyRule: if multiple players are attempting the jackpot, first trigger gets current full jackpot; other simultaneous triggerers receive the initial amount
titles.disconnectionRule: unfinished round state is remembered and can be resumed without a new wager

titles.trigger: 5 Wild/bell symbols on an active winning payline
titles.seedSemantics: restarts from a guaranteed initial amount after a jackpot win; exact amount not recovered in current public text
titles.poolScope: contributions from casinos offering the game

titles.trigger: 3 Clover symbols accumulated in Golden Coins Bonus
titles.seedSemantics: part of contribution funds progressive value and a smaller part funds initial guaranteed amount; exact split/seed not recovered
titles.poolScope: common jackpot generated across casinos offering Land of Gold

titles.game: Rulers of the World: Empire Treasures
titles.trigger: jackpot feature activates randomly on any spin from participating Empire Treasures games; entry guarantees one tier
titles.poolScope: shared across games/casinos carrying Empire Treasures

titles.game: Age of the Gods: King of Olympus
titles.trigger: jackpot game can activate randomly after any main-game spin; any bet eligible and chance scales proportionally with bet size; entry guarantees one tier
titles.poolScope: Age of the Gods network and described as sharing with Marvel Jackpot

titles.trigger: progressive can be won through either Wishing Well bonus gold at the bottom or lighting all seven Rainbow of Wealth colors
titles.eligibility: any spin of any bet can qualify when game conditions are met
titles.poolScope: accumulates across casinos offering the game

nationalResearchImplications: William Hill Spain exposes exact contribution and trigger semantics for titles whose other public operator pages may be much less specific.
Cross-operator same-title corroboration can validate provider/game mechanics but cannot prove identical RTP configuration, jackpot denomination or pool identity without a configuration fingerprint.
Seed formulas and stateful counters make deterministic/state-machine progressives materially easier to model than mystery jackpots if event probabilities can be recovered.
A Spain-wide catalog should preserve operator, provider, game version, tier and market separately instead of collapsing by game name.
